9: import { AddGerritAccountModal } from './AddGerritAccountModal'
10: import type { NormalizedExternalAccount } from './ExternalAccountsSignIn'
11: import { RemoveExternalAccountModal } from './RemoveExternalAccountModal'
12: 
13: interface Props {
14:     account: NormalizedExternalAccount
15:     authProvider: AuthProvider
16:     onDidRemove: (id: string, name: string) => void
17:     onDidError: (error: ErrorLike) => void
18:     onDidAdd: () => void
19: }
20: 
21: export function resolveAccountConnection(
22:     serviceType: AuthProvider['serviceType'],
23:     account: NormalizedExternalAccount
24: ): JSX.Element | string {
25:     switch (serviceType) {
26:         case 'openidconnect':
27:         case 'saml':
28:         case 'gerrit':
29:             return account.external?.displayName || 'Not connected'
30:         case 'azuredevops':
31:             return (
32:                 <>
33:                     {account.external?.displayName ? (
34:                         <>
35:                             {account.external.displayName} (@{account.external?.login})
36:                         </>
37:                     ) : (
38:                         'Not connected'
39:                     )}
40:                 </>
41:             )
42:         default:
43:             return (
44:                 <>
45:                     {account.external?.url ? (
46:                         <>
47:                             {account.external.displayName} (
48:                             <Link to={account.external.url} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
49:                                 @{account.external.login}
